thread:
Anna Patel: opened a PR with a small "dry-run" checklist for the offline installer (KMS/HSM/network sanity checks). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
Kevin Wong: nice. can you add a tiny `curl`/`nc` example to verify KMS port + a note about snat/broken double-nat? also call out proxy env var behavior for airgapped installs. :eyes:
Anna Patel: yep. planning to add `curl --connect-timeout 5 https://kms.internal:443` and a short `nc -vz kms.internal 443` snippet. thinking about including both `iptables` and `nft` minimal examples for SNAT notes.
Sara Liu: please prefer minimal, least-privilege examples. we should not recommend broad SNAT rules in the docs. maybe a limited MASQUERADE snippet + a note about calico/nat-outgoing.
Sara Liu: example (minimal):
```bash
# limit SNAT to cluster CIDR (example)
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.96.0.0/12 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```
Jamal Ortiz: also add a troubleshooting bullet about nftables vs iptables — some customers use distro-default nft and see rules not applied. mention `iptables-nft` shims.
Anna Patel: good call. i'll add a short nft example and a line: "if distro uses nft by default, ensure compatibility or install iptables-legacy".
Jamal Ortiz: another tip: systemd env override for the installer is handy in proxy setups. small snippet:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/offline-installer.service.d/proxy.conf
[Service]
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy:3128 NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,kms.internal,10.96.0.0/12
```
Kevin Wong: on the KMS/HSM side, call out PKCS#11 path perms and common `permission denied` on /dev/hsm0. add quick `ls -l` check and chmod guidance (but warn about security).
Sara Liu: i'll add a short "common gotchas" table with: TLS handshake failures, CA missing, PKCS#11 perms, nft/iptables mismatch, proxy env mistakes.
docs-bot: PR 421 updated: labels set to [docs, offline-installer], requested reviewers: @Sara Liu
Kevin Wong: can someone run the dry-run on the staging VM (10.244.12.7) and paste any noisy logs? @Jamal can you? :pray:
Jamal Ortiz: running now, will paste results.
Jamal Ortiz: quick log excerpt:
```text
2026-02-14T12:03:10Z installer: starting dry-run
2026-02-14T12:03:12Z network: curl https://kms.internal:443 -> TLS handshake: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-02-14T12:03:12Z kms: connection failed (retrying)
2026-02-14T12:03:18Z installer: dry-run completed with warnings
```
Jamal Ortiz: fix was adding customer CA to system trust store then `update-ca-certificates` — dry-run succeeded afterwards.
Anna Patel: thanks — i'll add a CA trust step and an example command to the checklist. also a short note to include HSM device permission checks before running installer.
Sara Liu: after you update, ping me and i'll do a quick pass and merge. :thumbsup:
infra-eng-bot: heads-up: offline-installer artifacts changed, please add a brief "what changed" section to release notes — https://internal/releases/installer
Anna Patel: will add release blurb. planning to push update to PR today, will ping reviewers when ready.
Kevin Wong: awesome, thanks team. once merged i'll wire the new snippets into the onboarding runbook. :shipit:"
